cells.text: Heavy Trajectory | Scan Scans up to 4 enemies in Line of Sight within 8.5 metres upon impact, firing a bolt of Solar Light towards scanned enemies after a 1 second delay. Solar Light Bolts deal 337 [65] damage and inflict x20+10 Scorch.
Scans up to ↑5 enemies in Line of Sight within ↑12 metres upon impact.

Enhances certain Grenade types: Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds. Firebolt Grenades seek radius is increased by 50% to 12 meters and target up to 5 enemies. Fusion Grenades explode again after 0.5 seconds, dealing up to 851 [50] damage in a 8 metre radius.

compendium.normalization: Whitespace collapsed; original source coordinates retained separately from CSV snapshot.

clarity.coverage: Touch of Flame 83039193 only; no standalone Firebolt Grenade named entry in this pinned file.

official.supports: Secondary seekers apply 20 Scorch stacks; historical mechanism, not a current trajectory or full damage calibration.
Firebolt included in grenades gaining 15 percent damage against bosses, minibosses and Champions; must check how source base damage incorporates target modifiers before composing.

requirements.impact_scan: Up to 4 enemies in line of sight within 8.5m; Touch of Flame up to 5 within 12m. Scan on impact, then one-second delay before secondary bolts.
requirements.damage_and_scorch: Secondary Solar bolts 337 PvE / 65 PvP and 20 Scorch, 30 with Ember of Ashes; reuse shared Solar attribution and lockout.
requirements.engine_dependency: Optional typed destination life reference must survive delayed launch and every seek/arrival/catch check. Existing identity-only destinations keep their semantics; no global feedback guard.

conflicts: Firebolt row says 8.5m base, whereas Touch of Flame summary says 50 percent to 12m and Clarity explicitly says 8→12m. Do not multiply 8.5 by 1.5 or treat this as three-way numeric agreement.
uncertainties: Heavy trajectory and secondary seekers do not supply speed, gravity, drag, turn rate, dimensions, scan-anchor offset, bolt origin or travel lifetime.

Nearest ordering, scan-time life binding, post-scan movement/cover/relationship changes, intervening entity collision, per-target application and modifier snapshot boundaries require explicit content policy and further calibration.
Base-damage projection and 2025 tier multiplier composition, Scorch receipt qualification and all Aspect/exotic/artifact combinations are not proven by generic engine tests.
not_claimed: Physical content chain is a partial reference producer, not a calibrated D2 physics/damage table, complete Touch of Flame, or production subclass/HUD/restart integration.

implementation.policy: Fixed scan and captured lives; delayed same-life revalidation, physical secondary seekers, cast-time Touch/Ashes/outgoing snapshots, live recipient player classification, no post-scan faction recheck. Explicitly uncalibrated target-tier damage profile.
